topic: T-Shirt के हेम में दो लाइन दिखें — वो कौन सी सिलाई है और क्यों?
reason: The Short explains the 406 coverseam stitch on T-shirt hems. However, the visual used between 14s and 20s to demonstrate coverseam stretch shows two applied braided trims or heavy decorative cords rather than an authentic 406 coverseam structure.

topic: धुलाई के बाद टी-शर्ट टेढ़ी क्यों हो जाती है? — Twist Liveliness का असली कारण
reason: The video uses a heavy rib-knit fabric to illustrate single jersey loop deformation and demonstrates garment skew using an artificially hand-pinched swirl.
